# Fix deployed schemas paths. Add configs.

## Pull Request by @tomusdrw

Currently deployed schemas reference files with a folder structure that is flattened by deployment. This PR fixes this by simply copying all configs & schemas and maintain the structure.

## Comment by @coderabbitai[bot]

_🛠️ Refactor suggestion_

_⚠️ Potential issue_

**Make copy step robust: ensure dest dirs exist, include dotfiles, handle deletions.**

`cp -r ./configs/* ...` will fail if `./web/configs` or `./web/schemas` don’t exist, will skip dotfiles, and won’t remove files deleted from `configs`. Use a single sync step with mkdir + rsync (or `cp -a` fallback). 



```diff
-    - name: Copy configs & schemas (configs dir)
-      run: cp -r ./configs/* ./web/configs/
-    - name: Copy configs & schemas (schemas dir)
-      run: cp -r ./configs/* ./web/schemas/
+    - name: Sync configs & schemas
+      run: |
+        mkdir -p ./web/configs ./web/schemas
+        rsync -a --delete ./configs/ ./web/configs/
+        rsync -a --delete ./configs/ ./web/schemas/
+      shell: bash
```

If rsync is undesirable, this also works (keeps dotfiles, tolerates empty dirs, but won’t delete removed files):
```diff
+    - name: Copy configs & schemas (cp fallback)
+      if: ${{ always() && false }} # enable if you can't use rsync
+      run: |
+        mkdir -p ./web/configs ./web/schemas
+        shopt -s dotglob nullglob
+        cp -a ./configs/. ./web/configs/
+        cp -a ./configs/. ./web/schemas/
+      shell: bash
```
